target: Install a pinned, semantics-preserving admission protocol for OpenAI Math material without turning adjacent prophet/secretary, information-theory, Gaussian experiment, or memory lower-bound results into bandit/RL theorems before an explicit ABRL reduction is proved.

reuse_plan.decision_reason: This contribution changes repository admission policy and provenance metadata only. It adds no Lean declaration and deliberately rejects automatic theorem reuse until semantic adapters/reductions exist.

semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: No source-facing theorem is added. Every future theorem admitted under this protocol still requires the repository semantic round trip and independent source review.

graph_contribution.functor_reason: The PR installs intake rules and candidate route metadata; it does not stabilize any mathematical bridge or formal dependency.
graph_contribution.visual_review: No reader graph is changed; future admitted routes must update the relevant graph surfaces under the normal publication protocol.

progress_updates.teaching_route: no-change-with-reason: no bandit/RL teaching theorem is promoted
progress_updates.banditrlwiki: no-change-with-reason: intake candidates are not reader-facing completed results
progress_updates.results_ledger: no-change-with-reason: no theorem or milestone status is changed
progress_updates.roadmap: updated: protocol-only external-formalization intake map added; adjacent routes remain non-completion candidates

truth_boundary: This PR does not claim that OpenAI Math contains a direct bandit or RL formalization, does not promote prophet/secretary results to bandit regret, and does not turn Gaussian/information/memory results into ABRL lower bounds. Solid Lean edges require future local compiled adapters or reductions.
